title: token-efficiency.md's dedup bullet says the shared arm was cheaper in USD in each paired record instead of calling the gap inside the spread
goal: the coord dedup bullet of kb/_self/token-efficiency.md states the USD ranges as they are (research shared 3.94-5.01 against isolated 5.05-5.60, coord 1.73-1.77 against 1.99-3.14: no overlap, shared cheaper) and keeps 'not shown' only for tokens and duplicate facts, without the $0.04 nearest-ends figure (reviewer of SP-p46hofrg on ST-sn25w6jm)

run:
import re
t = open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
b = [l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith('- **Coord dedup')]
assert b, 'no coord dedup bullet'
assert '$0.04' not in b[0], 'the bullet still gives the nearest-ends USD figure as the gap'
